description: This file defines the QuicSentPacketManagerPeer class, a test utility class providing static methods to access and modify internal states of QuicSentPacketManager objects for testing purposes.

classes.name: QuicSentPacketManagerPeer
classes.description: A test utility class with static methods to manipulate and inspect QuicSentPacketManager instances.

methods.name: SetPerspective
methods.description: Sets the perspective of the QuicSentPacketManager.

methods.name: GetSendAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the send algorithm used by the QuicSentPacketManager.

methods.name: SetSendAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the send algorithm for the QuicSentPacketManager.

methods.name: GetLossAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the loss detection algorithm used by the QuicSentPacketManager.

methods.name: SetLossAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the loss detection algorithm for the QuicSentPacketManager.

methods.name: GetRttStats
methods.description: Gets the RTT statistics from the QuicSentPacketManager.

methods.name: IsRetransmission
methods.description: Checks if a packet number corresponds to a retransmission.

methods.name: MarkForRetransmission
methods.description: Marks a packet for retransmission.

methods.name: GetNumRetransmittablePackets
methods.description: Returns the number of retransmittable packets.

methods.name: SetConsecutivePtoCount
methods.description: Sets the consecutive PTO count.

methods.name: GetBandwidthRecorder
methods.description: Retrieves the bandwidth recorder.

methods.name: SetUsingPacing
methods.description: Enables or disables pacing.

methods.name: UsingPacing
methods.description: Checks if pacing is enabled.

methods.name: HasRetransmittableFrames
methods.description: Checks if a packet has retransmittable frames.

methods.name: GetUnackedPacketMap
methods.description: Retrieves the unacked packet map.

methods.name: DisablePacerBursts
methods.description: Disables pacer bursts.

methods.name: GetPacerInitialBurstSize
methods.description: Gets the initial burst size for the pacer.

methods.name: SetNextPacedPacketTime
methods.description: Sets the time for the next paced packet.

methods.name: GetReorderingShift
methods.description: Retrieves the reordering shift value.

methods.name: AdaptiveReorderingThresholdEnabled
methods.description: Checks if adaptive reordering threshold is enabled.

methods.name: AdaptiveTimeThresholdEnabled
methods.description: Checks if adaptive time threshold is enabled.

methods.name: UsePacketThresholdForRuntPackets
methods.description: Checks if packet threshold is used for runt packets.

methods.name: GetNumPtosForPathDegrading
methods.description: Retrieves the number of PTOs for path degrading.

methods.name: GetPeerEcnCounts
methods.description: Retrieves ECN counts for the peer.
